From: Darby, David <dfdarby@freepress.com>

To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Don't say I didn't warn you
I'm sure we can commiserate some night around 2 am when I am on the web and you are finishing up a 12-inning Tigers game.
But it's good to stick around (sort of) and it was nice the Powers That Be still wanted me to do so, too.

Best, 
D From: Fenech, Anthony
Sent: Sunday, September 20, 2015 4:33:24 AM
To: Darby, David
Subject: Don't say I didn't warn you 
 
About working the web ...
But I'm glad you're staying aboard.
